Abyss

Item Level: 83
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Scorching" (Tier: 4) — Damage, Elemental, Fire, Minion }
Minions deal 15(15-18) to 22(21-24) additional Fire Damage
{ Suffix Modifier "of Righteousness" (Tier: 1) — Chaos, Resistance, Minion }
Minions have +8(7-11)% to Chaos Resistance
--------
Place into an Abyssal Socket on an Item or into an allocated Jewel Socket on the Passive Skill Tree. Right click to remove from the Socket.
